label_method.answer_convention: 仅 case-03/04 的模拟回答选 highest_revision；该选项须说明最大整数修订、并列相同折叠/冲突拒绝的完整语义，不应仅传未解释的标签作为业务授权。case-06 的 rule 是明确留到运行的参数，编制阶段不注入答案。
label_method.description: 由独立 Codex 子角色在读取被测生成结果之前，逐行审阅八份原始 Skill、唯一被引用的 details.md 及首版 SPEC 的原始业务契约；按原文而不是预期程序输出确定状态、模式、规则和阻塞源行。
label_method.scope: 小型声明订单契约语义验证集；非人类盲评，非算法收益 holdout，不支持总体语言理解准确率或成本收益外推。
label_method.state_convention: delivered 表示定义编制可交付，不表示实际订单任务已经运行、验收或发布；waiting_info 表示编制规则有缺口；stopped 必须因指定未支持原要求而阻止完整交付。

rubric.infrastructure: stop first provider/infrastructure error, retain attempted case and report not-run cases
rubric.interpretation_limit: 8 developer-constructed cases, independent Codex role labels; no human blind review or population accuracy/algorithm-benefit claim
rubric.limits: max 12 request reservations per case, max 3 requests per port, 4096 output tokens/request; no automatic retry or repair
rubric.positive: initial state, rule interpretation, mode, independent review, source identity/coverage, rule domain and parent contract, correspondence
rubric.question: one scoped rule question with complete registered meanings; answer only after question; independent review again
rubric.rejection: unsupported requirement or independent semantic rejection must locate the exact frozen offending line with a nonempty reason; arbitrary failure is incorrect
